The name Naqi is a reminder of the importance of striving for spiritual growth and self-improvement, and the role of spiritual leadership in guiding individuals towards a closer relationship with the Divine. historical_references.reference: Imam Al-Naqi (as) was the eleventh Imam of the Twelver Shia branch of Islam, born in Medina in 37 AH (657 AD). He was known for his extensive knowledge of the Quran and Hadith.

Al-Naqi (as) is also known as Imam Ali ibn Muhammad al-Hadi, and during his brief rule, he was a calming influence in the midst of political instability in Iraq, where the Abbasid Caliphate was based.

Sufis and those interested in Sufi teachings can be found on various social media platforms, such as Twitter, Instagram, and YouTube.
